payload.claim: The spec's notes name `_stub_the_runtime` (here, where `worktree.dirty_paths` is stubbed) as one of 'four such sites' that must also stub the new `worktree.spec_ids`, 'otherwise the listing reaches the cell runtime.' No companion `monkeypatch.setattr("saffron.cell.worktree.spec_ids", ...)` was added here, unlike the three sites fixed in `tests/test_package.py`. In practice no test breaks, because this fixture already stubs `saffron.cell.runtime.exec_` itself (line 1281) with a catch-all that logs the call and returns `Completed(0, "", "")`, which `spec_ids`'s own parsing turns into `[]` without raising — the one test that asserts an exact command list against a container where the gate suite runs (`test_the_lens_gate_cell_holds_no_credential_and_is_gone_before_any_lens_runs`) was correctly updated to include `_SPEC_IDS`. But this leaves `_stub_the_runtime`'s explicit, named stub for `dirty_paths` sitting beside an unstubbed sibling that only works by falling through a lower-level catch-all, contrary to the spec's explicit instruction and to the pattern every other site in this diff follows.
